risks.risk: TV is not a Samsung or is not 55-inch
risks.proof: Photo showing the brand logo or model label on the TV frame or back.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a generic 55-inch TV, not Samsung, which reduces value.

risks.risk: Screen has dead pixels or lines not visible in off state
risks.proof: Photo of the screen displaying a test pattern (e.g., white, black, red, green, blue) or a video showing full screen.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as having potential screen defects, reducing value.

risks.risk: Remote is not included or is damaged
risks.proof: Photo of the remote control and its battery compartment, or a video showing it working.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as missing remote, reducing value.

risks.risk: TV is not functional or has hidden damage (e.g., ports, stand, power supply)
risks.proof: Photo of the back of the TV showing ports, power cord, and stand, or a video showing it powering on and displaying content.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not working, reducing value.

proof_requests: Photo of the back of the TV showing brand, model, and ports.
Photo of the remote control and its battery compartment.
Photo of the TV powered on, displaying a test pattern or video.
Photo of the stand and power cord.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
